member_of.name: Art Katex, The Architects of Art (podcast host)

podcast.title: Broke Production Company with "Topstar" Video – DJ Khaled, Drake, Bieber
podcast.body: He broke his production company, Fella, with the music video for DJ Khaled, Drake, and Justin Bieber's "Topstar." This project was a significant breakthrough for the two directors from Brampton, Ontario. "Like, we broke our production company, Fella, with this music video for DJ Khaled, Drake, and Bieber called Topstar."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Co-Host of Art Katex Podcast – Architects of Art
podcast.body: Tadges Chris Lowe is a co-host of the podcast "Art Katex, The Architects of Art," which serves as another medium for storytelling about the creative journey of music video directors. "Now we're using our podcast as another former storytelling, but through an audio medium."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Prominent Music Video Director – Longstanding Career
podcast.body: Tadges Chris Lowe, also referred to as Director X, is recognized for his long and relevant career in music video directing, dating from the late 90s to the present. He co-hosts the "Art Katex" podcast, celebrating music video artists. "And I would say X is the goat because as long as he's been doing it, like late 90s to now, it's still relevant."
